text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through the city, I spotted
K.S. Miracle about to enter a diner.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san.
Would you like to have lunch together, if you'd like?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
What should I do... Everything looks so delicious,
I can't decide what to eat...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I had a medical exam at the hospital,
so I wasn't allowed to eat anything since last night.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Food always tastes
so much better after an exam, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ...Alright! Today I'll have this, and this... and also 4 carrot rape sandwiches, let's go for it!
choice_data_list: If you try to cram it all in at once, you'll shock your body, you know?
Let's eat until we're completely stuffed!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha, that's true...
I guess I got a little carried away.
choice_data_list: Let's savor what we love and enjoy our food!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Yes, absolutely! Thank you for the advice, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that was delicious... Hehe.
Being able to appreciate good food is such a blessing.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I'll be done eating in a sec too!
Sorry, I'll be done eating in just a second!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
No, take your time.
Actually, are you sure you don't want to order anything else?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
"Since I can't eat much myself, I actually kind of
enjoy watching others eat... Yeah."

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: I want to watch you eat delicious food even more... Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I enjoyed a meal
together with K.S. Miracle.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... I got carried away
and ate a bit too much...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
I'm okay... but if I take
the test again right now, I feel like I'll fail...

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Just because you're feeling energetic, you shouldn't
overestimate your stomach's capacity... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
K.S.Miracle thoroughly enjoyed
a meal larger than her usual portion.
